title: Chevron To Rally Around 12%? Here Are 10 Top Analyst Forecasts For Friday
text: Get the latest analyst rating changes for top companies on Wall Street, including upgrades and downgrades. View complete details at Benzinga.
author: avi kapoor
teaser: Get the latest analyst rating changes for top companies on Wall Street, including upgrades and downgrades. View complete details at Benzinga.
body_text:
Top Wall Street analysts changed their outlook on these top names. For a complete view of all analyst rating changes, including upgrades and downgrades, please see our analyst ratings page.

Morgan Stanley raised the price target for Spotify Technology SA (NYSE:SPOT) from $590 to $610. Morgan Stanley analyst Manan Gosalia maintained an Overweight rating. Spotify shares closed at $489.93 on Thursday. See how other analysts view this stock.

JP Morgan increased Sweetgreen Inc (NYSE:SG) price target from $8 to $13. JP Morgan analyst Rahul Krotthapalli upgraded the stock from Neutral to Overweight. Sweetgreen shares closed at $8.98 on Thursday. See how other analysts view this stock.

Goldman Sachs raised price target for Advance Auto Parts Inc (NYSE:AAP) from $49 to $54. Goldman Sachs analyst Kate McShane maintained a Sell rating. Advance Auto Parts shares closed at $58.62 on Thursday. See how other analysts view this stock.

Jefferies increased the price target for Generac Holdings Inc (NYSE:GNRC) from $239 to $302. Jefferies analyst Tanner James upgraded the stock from Hold to Buy. Generac shares closed at $247.79 on Thursday. See how other analysts view this stock.

Barrington Research slashed Orthofix Medical Inc (NASDAQ:OFIX) price target from $17 to $15. Barrington Research analyst Michael Petusky maintained an Outperform rating. Orthofix Medical shares closed at $10.41 on Thursday. See how other analysts view this stock.

Stifel cut Zoetis Inc (NYSE:ZTS) price target from $105 to $95. Stifel analyst Jonathan Block maintained a Hold rating. Zoetis shares closed at $80.07 on Thursday. See how other analysts view this stock.

Piper Sandler cut Lululemon Athletica Inc (NASDAQ:LULU) price target from $190 to $130. Piper Sandler analyst Anna Andreeva maintained a Neutral rating. Lululemon shares closed at $126.76 on Thursday. See how other analysts view this stock.

Ascendiant Capital raised the price target for Travelzoo (NASDAQ:TZOO) from $22 to $23. Ascendiant Capital analyst Edward Woo maintained a Buy rating. Travelzoo shares closed at $9.49 on Thursday. See how other analysts view this stock.

Deutsche Bank boosted Lattice Semiconductor Corp (NASDAQ:LSCC) price target from $150 to $175. Deutsche Bank analyst Melissa Weathers maintained a Buy rating. Lattice Semiconductor shares closed at $139.35 on Wednesday. See how other analysts view this stock.

Morgan Stanley raised Chevron Corp (NYSE:CVX) price target from $212 to $214. Morgan Stanley analyst Devin McDermott maintained an Overweight rating. Chevron shares closed at $191.01 on Thursday. See how other analysts view this stock.
